utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — I’m keeping an eye out for the repair drive details, and I’ll do my part as soon as they come through.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — could you give me the quickest update you have on the repair drive? If Cleo’s checking the supply list, that’d help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I still haven’t gotten Mara’s repair drive details yet, but I’m watching for them and will jump in as soon as they arrive. If Cleo’s on the supply list, that should help us keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need screws, duct tape, and one replacement hinge. I can check what’s already been donated and give Nell a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll sort the donations and keep an eye on the tools. Let me know what’s still missing once you check.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the donations and update Nell on what’s still missing. Then we can see if the screws, duct tape, and hinge are covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the donations and make a missing-items list. Faye can help from 9:30 to 11:30, around school drop-off and pick-up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by to help sort the pile too. I’ve got a drill and a few spare screws if those come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — bring the drill and screws, and I’ll keep sorting the donations. If you spot any missing hardware, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll put together a quick supplies list and check in with a few neighbors about donations. Once Oren gets the details, he can help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara. I’d really appreciate the extra hands—Mina will be there at 10 a.m., so that should help us get a good start.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great — I’ll send Oren the details and keep nudging the neighbors about donations. Mina being there at 10 should make a solid start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I’m waiting on confirmation before I tell anyone else about the repair drive. Once the pickup time’s locked down, Pia said she’ll say who’s handling it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll put together a simple task list for the repair drive, and Vik can pass it around once it’s ready. Opal’s handling the drop-offs at the community center front desk, so that should help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — I still just need the pickup time confirmed before I pass it on. Once that’s set, I can tell the others.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s coming together really well—people are dropping off tools and donations already. I’ll let Rey know if I hear they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. I’ll follow the plan once Quinn sends it over, and I’m happy to help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds great, Eli—once Quinn sends the plan, we’ll be set. I’ll keep you posted if I hear they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’ll send Bo the repair details as soon as I’m back. If I hear anything new about the drive, I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira. I’m keeping the locations straight for the repair drive, so just send Bo the details when you’re back and I’ll slot everything by address.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll get the details to Bo when I’m back, and I’ll pass along anything new I hear about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. If Leo can sort the donations and make the missing-items list, that would help me a lot with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep it brief and wait on the repair details from Ira. If Leo can handle the donations list, that helps me too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate you waiting on Ira — that’ll make it easier to keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:30 to 11:30 still works for me—I’ll plan around school drop-off and pick-up. Hana can check the repair list and school times, and let us know if anything needs adjusting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye. I’ll stop by the repair drive and help out if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep the school times in mind and let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check with the others and make sure we’re all on the same page about the repair drive. I’ll circle back and keep the plan clear for the whole block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’m putting the repair drive notes in order by location, and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Rosa — I’ll spread the word and check back with the others so the repair drive stays clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll be there at 10 a.m. for the repair drive. Do you still need extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please — I still need extra hands, and I’ll share the task list and start time today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’m in. Send the task list when you can, and I’ll be there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the pickup time and drop-off spot before I can commit. Once Quinn sends those details, please loop me in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools and hand them out as folks arrive, and I’ll keep an eye out for Eli’s notes and the open items. Once Quinn sends the pickup time and drop-off spot, I’ll loop you in right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — that works for me. I’m still holding off until Quinn sends the timing and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s great to hear. I’ll stop by the repair drive and lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m waiting on the timing and pickup details before I can commit. Quinn said they’d send the drop-off spot and loop me in, and Kira was asking about the pickup time and who’s handling it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — just send me the drop-off spot and pickup time when you have them, and I’ll come by to help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by to help sort the pile, and I’ve got a drill plus a few spare screws if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds helpful, but can you confirm the pickup time first? I’m waiting on that before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure — once I hear the pickup time, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s coming together really well — people have been dropping off tools and donations all day. I’ll let Rey know if I hear they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear — I’ll put together the task list and head to the community center to check in at the front desk. Vik can spread the word and pass it along to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect — the task list and front desk check-in will really help. I’ll keep an ear out and let Rey know if they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the repair list and the pickup times against the school schedule first, then I’ll confirm the details to Kira.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll check with the others and repeat the repair drive plan so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik. I’m checking the schedule now, and I’ll confirm the repair drive details to Kira once everything lines up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll be there at 10 a.m. for the repair drive. Do you need extra hands for anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’ll pass along the repair details to Bo as soon as I’m back. If I hear anything from Vik or the others, I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. If you hear what needs doing, let me know and I’ll bring extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll sort the donations and keep an eye on the tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll sort the donated tools and hand them out as folks arrive. Eli’s bringing the latest notes, so we can get started without any fuss.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep sorting the donations and watch the tools. Thanks for handling the handouts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:30 to 11:30 works for me — I’ll plan around school drop-off and pick-up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll share the task list and the start time today so everyone can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. Send it over when you can, and I’ll keep it lined up with school drop-off and pick-up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll put together a quick supplies list and check with a few neighbors about donations, then I’ll pass the details to Oren so he can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara. Leo’s sorting the donations and making the missing-items list, so that’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, that helps a lot. I’ll send Oren the details and keep checking in with a few neighbors about any extra donations.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll bring the latest notes to the repair drive. Just let me know the start time when Quinn shares it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — Mina will be there at 10 a.m., and I could still use a few extra hands. If Quinn sends the start time, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 a.m. works for me. I’m happy to help and I’ll be there with the latest notes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Leo, any quick update on the repair drive? I heard Cleo can check the supply list if needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — I’m sorting the donations now and making the missing-items list. If Cleo wants, I can send over the supply list after I finish.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great — just send me the quick update when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m grouping the repair drive notes by address so each spot stays together. Mara’s doing a quick supplies list, too, so we’ll be set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that’ll make it much easier to track each location. I’m keeping the addresses straight on my end, and Jules can check in at the community center front desk when he gets there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — that’ll keep everything tidy, and I’ll keep each address together as I finish the notes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I’m still keeping an eye out for the repair drive details, and I’ll do my part once Mara sends them through.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — just send me the short missing list when you have it. I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll send you the short missing list as soon as the repair drive details come through.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
